newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Rates fall at Tunisia's negotiable bonds.
newsitem.headline: Rates fall at Tunisia's negotiable bonds.

text.p: The Tunisian treasury on Tuesday raised 4.5 million dinars from February's issue of treasury bonds negotiable at the bourse (BTNB) at rates falling in a highly liquid market.
It said it sold five-year paper payable in equal annual tranches worth four million dinars at a 8.4000 percent coupon rate down from 8.5000 percent previously.
It also sold ten-year bonds payable in equal annual tranche worth 0.5 million dinars at a 9.000 percent, from 9.5000 previously.
Bids amounted to 55.98 million dinars for five-, ten- and 15-year paper at between 8.4000 and 10.25 percent.
BTNB are issued each month on the first Tuesday. ($=1.04 dinar)
